description: 台灣自來水公司每度用水CO2排放量 [drinking water supply] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 台灣自來水股份有限公司. 由於氣候變遷逐漸威脅人類的生活環境，而人類大量使用化石燃料所產生的二氧化碳，使得大氣中二氧化碳濃度日益增加，成為地球暖化現象主要原因，如無有效控制二氧化碳的排放，情形有可能更加嚴重。 台灣自來水公司配合政府積極推動各項節能減碳政策，除宣導用戶節約用水外，讓用戶瞭解每度用水CO2排放量是有其必要性，期藉以提倡用戶節約用水亦能減少碳排放量的觀... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 台灣自來水股份有限公司. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-06-30 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
